title: Pricing and connection modes
intro: TestFlight includes all features without a purchase or subscription. These are planned US prices for the first commercial release; paid products are not available yet.

sections.heading: Personal
paragraphs: For your main machine and one more computer.

sections.heading: Personal Plus
paragraphs: For several working machines and projects.

sections.heading: Fleet
paragraphs: For a larger personal fleet of computers.

sections.heading: The same core product in every plan.
paragraphs: The number of managed computers changes. Task control, history and supported integrations stay available in each plan.
Actions depend on the provider, installed runtime and adapter. Repository analysis requires GrantTap Engine on the computer. Technical limits and service protections apply.
bullets: Linked Mac, iPhone and iPad clients; quick Watch decisions through iPhone
Encrypted delivery and a bounded server queue
Tasks, history, Project Mesh and project rules
Supported ways to continue agent work; no separate per-agent or per-task charge

sections.heading: Mac Local — $39.99 once
paragraphs: Prefer local control and your own relay? Buy Mac Local once. No Personal subscription is required for that mode. Managed hosting is not included. Active Personal already covers Mac as a managed client; you do not need both purchases for managed access.

sections.heading: What counts as a computer?
paragraphs: One stable computer enabled to publish agent work through the managed service. Multiple agents and projects on it do not use extra seats. iPhone, iPad, Watch and controller-only Macs do not add execution-computer seats.

sections.heading: Do I need Personal and Mac Local?
paragraphs: Not for managed mode. Active Personal provides managed access to your linked Mac. Mac Local is the separate one-time purchase for local control and your own relay.

sections.heading: Are AI models and tokens included?
paragraphs: No. You use your own provider accounts and plans. GrantTap manages supported executions; it does not replace a model subscription.

sections.heading: What remains after cancellation?
paragraphs: Paid access continues until the stated date unless the entitlement is separately revoked. Downloaded local history, chats and images are not deleted. A purchased Mac Local license remains valid.

sections.heading: Is Fleet a team plan?
paragraphs: Fleet increases your managed-computer allowance. It is not an enterprise package, an SLA or a fifteen-person license. Supported Project Mesh collaboration remains available.

sections.heading: Do I pay separately for Apple Watch?
paragraphs: No. Supported Watch actions work through your paired iPhone. The watch is not a standalone execution computer.

sections.heading: Purchase terms
paragraphs: A 7-day free trial is available to eligible new subscribers when Apple offers it. Your selected monthly plan follows. Trial eligibility appears in the purchase sheet.

Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Manage or cancel in Apple subscription settings. Apple shows the terms and effective date of a plan change. Ending Personal does not delete downloaded local data or revoke a purchased Mac Local license.
USD prices are US launch prices. The App Store purchase sheet controls availability, local pricing, offer terms and the next charge. No annual plans are offered at first launch.
